m3-laneA 2026-08-05 round-8 bucket-3 (nan f32) ROOT-CAUSED, NOT landed (blocker escalation) — 30 shaders (polyline/overlay_armature/workbench_shadow/eevee_shadow/gpencil/edit_curve/motion_path). Root cause: NAN_FLT sentinel = `#define NAN_FLT uintBitsToFloat(0x7FC00000u)` (gpu_shader_utildefines_lib.glsl:20), used as `gl_Position = float4(NAN_FLT)` to cull verts. glslang's FRONT-END const-folds uintBitsToFloat(literal) into a NaN `OpConstant %float` (independent of the optimizer — our compiler already runs optimize=false), the Tint SPIR-V reader ingests it as a NaN f32 core::constant, and the WGSL writer (ProgramFromIR, ir_to_program.cc:990 b.Expr(ValueAs<f32>())) builds a float-LITERAL AST node that fails resolution because WGSL forbids NaN/Inf literals → "tint ProgramFromIR: value nan cannot be represented as f32". No clean lever inside lane-A ownership: tint reader/writer Options expose no nan flag (spirv/reader/common/options.h has only sampler_mappings/dump/asserts), there is no core-IR nan-legalization transform, and disabling optimization does nothing (glslang folds at parse). ESCALATION (driver): cleanest fix is a WebGPU variant of NAN_FLT that survives to WGSL as `bitcast<f32>(0x7fc00000u)` (which WGSL permits) — but gpu_shader_utildefines_lib.glsl is a shared shader source (read-only, all backends) and keying it on `#ifdef GPU_WEBGPU` is impossible today because standard_defines (gpu/intern/gpu_shader.cc:169-182) has NO GPU_BACKEND_WEBGPU case — it hits `default: BLI_assert_msg(false)` and defines NO backend macro (separate latent gap: `#ifdef GPU_VULKAN/METAL/OPENGL` are all false under WebGPU and there is no GPU_WEBGPU to branch on). In-lane alternative = a custom Tint-IR pass (ReadIR→walk→replace NaN/Inf f32 scalar+vec-splat constants with core::ir::Bitcast from a u32 const→ProgramFromIR) in wgpu_shader_compiler.cc; feasible with the linked Tint IR API but non-trivial (vector-splat handling, per-use insertion) and risks the banked 481 — bounded to a future round, not attempted this round to protect the bucket-2 gain. bucket-2 patch 0050 intact; static_shaders 481/973; bf_gpu+blender_test green; upstream HEAD fbe6228.
